title: Ingestion queue depth counter race under concurrent burst load
description: transit/peering/ingestion_queue.rs:67-85: depth counter uses Relaxed atomics throughout. is_full() reads a depth snapshot that is not synchronized with the drain task's decrement. Under burst load, a peer session can observe stale depth and bypass the 431 rejection. The 80% drain threshold check (depth * 10 < max * 8) races against concurrent decrements. Fix: use Acquire on depth load in is_full() and Release on decrement in recv(), or serialize queue acceptance behind a Mutex.
